title: PM Modi announces task force for exam reforms, Nandan Nilekani to lead
content: This task force will focus on examination reforms, and based on its report, steps will be taken to ensure the credibility of upcoming examinations at the earliest, says Prime Minister Narendra Modi in a post on Instagram

title: Kerala Police issue warning against cyber fraud using fake KTDC hotel booking websites
content: Fraudsters are primarily targeting users who search on Google using keywords such as 'KTDC Stay,' 'KTDC Hotels,' 'KTDC Booking' and 'KTDC Resort.' The fake websites are designed to closely resemble the official KTDC website, making it difficult for the public to distinguish between genuine and fraudulent platforms

title: Guru Tegh Bahadur’s sacrifice symbolises courage, service and compassion: Governor
content: Recalling Guru Tegh Bahadur’s supreme sacrifice in the defence of faith and religious freedom, Mr. Gehlot said the guru laid down his life to protect religion and its followers and was, therefore, revered as “Hind Di Chadar”

title: KPSC temporarily stays veterinary officer selection list, forms internal inquiry committee to review exam process
content: The Karnataka Public Service Commission (KPSC) temporarily put on hold the selection list for veterinary officers and formed an internal sub-committee to probe into allegations of malpractices during the conduct of exam and evaluation

title: BJP Kisan Morcha pitches crop diversification to tackle climate challenges
content: Party leaders urge farmers to reduce dependence on water-intensive paddy, promote efficient irrigation practices and ensure wider adoption of Union welfare schemes to improve resilience and farm incomes in Andhra Pradesh

title: Kargil Vijay Diwas: Soldiers’ sacrifice is the foundation of our freedom and security, says Karnataka CM D.K. Shivakumar
content: Recalling the conflict, Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar said 527 soldiers were martyred during the Kargil War, including 13 from Karnataka

title: Sharanabasaveshwar Sangha offers free education to 10 meritorious girls
content: The beneficiaries are students of the Kasturba Gandhi Girls Residential School in Kalaburagi, where classes are offered only up to class 8.

content: Among the major urban districts, Thane reported a distribution of 67.97% and digitisation of 27.56%, Mumbai Suburban 67.79% and 28.72%, Mumbai City 72.37% and 38.88%, while Pune recorded 70% distribution and 45.04% digitisation

title: Rising egg prices burn holes in consumers’ pockets
content: Apart from seasonal and weather factors, the ups and downs caused by the West Asia crisis appear to have hit the egg prices

title: From one man’s vision to a people’s movement, Clean Green Panunda sets an example in community participation
content: More than 60 volunteers clean nearly 3 km of roads, bus shelters and public spaces across Panunda, Pottanpara, Eruvatty, and Oliyakkara wards in Pinarayi pancayat every Sunday

title: Hyderabad Police urge mandatory verification of domestic help after 565 theft cases in two years
content: The police urged citizens to immediately report any suspicious activity by dialling 100 or contacting the Hyderabad City Police WhatsApp helpline at 94906 16555.

title: Depression in the Bay may bring isolated heavy rainfall to North Andhra Pradesh
content: The fresh system is likely to intensify further into a deep depression during the next 24 hours and cross the North Odisha and West Bengal coasts on July 27, says IMD

title: NSS objects to employment exchange route for temporary appointments in Kerala schools
content: Govt. circular requires managements of aided educational institutions to make appointments to temporary vacancies, including leave vacancies, only from the list provided by the exchange. NSS says the authority to make all appointments in an aided school is vested with the manager

title: Former Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah announces retirement from electoral politics, citing age and ‘polluted’ politics
content: Former Chief Minister Siddaramaiah has announced his retirement from electoral politics, while asserting that he will continue to remain active in public life and work for the Congress and the people

title: Two held for impersonating Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi’s aide in cyber fraud case
content: Elathur MLA Vidya Balakrishnan had received a phone call on July 6 from a person claiming to be the private secretary of the Wayanad MP, offering her a Cabinet Minister’s post in exchange for ₹3 crore. Growing suspicious, the MLA contacted the MP’s office, which confirmed it was a scam

title: BJP deploying unfair campaign practices ahead of Bankipur bypoll, says Prashant Kishor
content: The BJP is using the district administration to harass his party colleagues, and deploying ‘Jivika Didis’ for campaigning, founder of the Jan Suraaj Party says, warning of a sit-in protest

title: YSRCP seeks CBI probe into alleged DSC exam irregularities
content: Addressing the media, party leader and East Rayalaseema MLC alleges that the system has been compromised at every level and that the ruling dispensation deliberately tweaked the rules

title: MCC steps up public outreach for SIR form collection
content: As part of the campaign, the civic body deployed public announcement vehicles across various localities to inform citizens that SIR forms have been distributed to every household

title: Seeking drought declaration, Samyukta Horata Karnataka calls for ‘Kalaburagi Bandh’ on August 17
content: Samyukta Horata Karnataka says the drought devastated agriculture, depleted groundwater, dried up standing crops and triggered an acute drinking water crisis across the district.

title: Jeevan Jyoti vision centres strengthen rural eye care in Alwar
content: Vision centres under the Jeevan Jyoti Project are improving access to eye care in Alwar’s rural areas through screenings, cataract referrals and community outreach within the public health system

title: Delay in FIR, medical aid alleged in pregnant minor’s POCSO case
content: Child rights organisations say procedural lapses could have affected the victim’s health; police say the alleged delay will be part of the investigation

title: 'Hang culprits': Mother of NEET aspirant who died says Pradhan's exit not enough
content: Parents of Akanksha Chaturvedi demand justice and compensation after her suicide following the NEET-UG paper leak. They express dissatisfaction with Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation from his post. Akanksha's mother called for stricter punishment for those responsible for the examination controversy. Her father stated that his daughter aspired to become a doctor and serve the nation.

title: Sergey Brin says he fought Google's ban on engineers using Gemini
content: Google co-founder Sergey Brin discovered Gemini on an internal coding tool prohibition list. He spent weeks attempting to remove this restriction himself. After failing to resolve the issue, Brin approached CEO Sundar Pichai for assistance. Pichai proved supportive and helped lift the outdated restriction on Gemini usage. This incident highlights how internal rules can lag behind company AI strategies.

title: Thousands of Himachal teachers launch indefinite hunger strike against School Complex System
content: Thousands of primary teachers marched to Shimla after a 15-day foot journey. They launched an indefinite relay hunger strike against the new School Complex System. Federation leaders claimed the policy weakened primary education and affected teacher deployment. Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu assured that most demands were accepted. Teachers will continue their agitation until changes are formally notified.

title: Jeff Bezos ex-wife MacKenzie Scott helped write a 'donation playbook' for Snap founder
content: Snap co-founder Evan Spiegel and Miranda Kerr have donated $550 million to erase medical debt. This significant contribution will benefit over 261,000 Californians facing financial hardship. The donation follows a philanthropic model pioneered by MacKenzie Scott. Undue Medical Debt will administer the funds, targeting vulnerable residents statewide. This initiative aims to unburden families from unpayable medical expenses.

title: Nepal to require Everest climbers to prove experience first
content: Nepal has introduced new rules for climbing Mount Everest. Aspiring climbers must now summit a 7,000-meter peak first. This aims to reduce overcrowding and improve climber safety on the mountain. Experienced mountaineers support these new regulations for better preparation. Indian climbers will need to plan multi-year expeditions for their Everest dreams.

title: How Guatemala's logging system is helping save rainforests
content: Guatemala's Maya Biosphere Reserve is showing that forests can be protected while supporting local livelihoods. Communities legally harvest a limited number of trees under strict rules, restore degraded land and grow new forests. Officials say these community-managed concessions have maintained near-zero deforestation while creating jobs, boosting incomes and increasing forest cover.

title: Idaho Airbnb shaped like a ship earns $80,000 a year, now for sale
content: Nestled in Salmon, Idaho, a captivating pirate-themed house is on the market for $799,000, boasting a remarkable annual income of around $80,000 from its Airbnb bookings. The property stands out amidst a collection of luxurious and historic homes detailed in market reports. Economic shifts are shaping the landscape of luxury real estate, with affluent baby boomers opting for more spacious residences as they transition into retirement.

title: Amid billionaire exodus, NYC's Mamdani tells $5M homeowners: Check your mail
content: New York City's mayor is implementing a new tax on expensive second homes. This tax aims to fund essential public services across the city.  The city is currently experiencing an outflow of high-income residents to other states.  Meanwhile, major companies like Airbnb are expanding their presence in New York City.  These developments highlight ongoing economic shifts within the metropolitan area.

title: India’s first hydrogen-powered train saves 3,200 litres of diesel; Delhi route tests next
content: India's first hydrogen train has traveled over 1,200 kilometers during trial operations. This indigenous project has already saved over 3,200 liters of diesel fuel. The train generates electricity using hydrogen fuel cells, releasing only water vapor. Dedicated hydrogen storage and refuelling facilities have been established at Jind. Further trial runs are planned for the Delhi route to support zero-emission rail transport.

title: Sooryavanshi creates history, sets unique T20I record before turning 16
content: The left-handed opener achieved the feat during the third and final T20I against Zimbabwe in Harare on Sunday, scoring 81 off 48 balls to lead India to 192/5 after they elected to bat first.

title: ‘No law bars eating chicken over Ganga’: SC judge flags delayed bail at NLIU lecture
content: Justice Ujjal Bhuyan expressed concern over shrinking public space for dissent in India. He noted that courts often grant relief belatedly and impose restrictive bail conditions. These conditions can discourage citizens from exercising their fundamental right to express views. Justice Bhuyan cited cases where individuals faced prolonged jail time for minor offenses. He stressed the need for critical examination of judicial decisions to improve the system.

title: Patrick Mahomes says wife and kids gave meaning to his NFL greatness
content: Patrick Mahomes says his greatest strength is not just football but the support of his family. From overcoming injuries to balancing life as a husband and father, he credits Brittany Mahomes and their children for keeping him grounded. His emotional words and never-give-up mindset show that resilience, patience and love have shaped both his life and his legendary NFL career.

title: Gabriel Langton remains conscious after horrific Commonwealth Games fall
content: Gabriel Langton suffered a horrific fall during the men's team gymnastics final at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow after missing a catch on the high bar. The England gymnast was treated on the arena floor before being taken to hospital in a neck brace. Team England later shared an encouraging update on his condition. Here's everything we know about how the accident happened, the latest injury update, his current condition, and what it could mean for his recovery and return to competition.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes turned family grief into a mission of hope
content: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes attended a back-to-school event with FARE just before Chiefs training camp, continuing their advocacy for food allergy awareness. The couple's mission comes from personal experience after their children, Sterling and Bronze, were diagnosed with food allergies. Brittany has previously shared the frightening details of Bronze's severe allergic reaction and how it inspired the family to help others. Here's how Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes are using their platform to support parents and create safer environments for children with food allergies.

title: ‘Bahuda Yatra’ celebrated with religious fervour in Visakhapatnam
content: The return procession began from Turner’s Choultry on Main Road and proceeded to the Sri Jagannatha Swamy Temple on Town Kotta Road amid Vedic chanting, traditional music, drum beats, and fireworks

title: Nellore all set to distribute 10,000 bicycles to girl students on July 27
content: MA&UD Minister Ponguru Narayana’s self-funded project aims to reduce transportation costs for girls studying in 23 State-run high schools in his Nellore constituency, and those belonging to economically disadvantaged families

title: Political leaders from Andhra Pradesh pay rich tributes to Kargil martyrs
content: On Vijay Diwas, they recall the courage and supreme sacrifice of the warriors in upholding the honour of the Tricolour

title: Five-member expert committee visits STP sites
content: The five-member team also visited some of the polluted canals and localities in the city that lacked proper sewage management systems

title: Case against six media organisations in Kerala for circulating fake news on CPI(M) leader P.K. Sreemathi’s pension
content: Case registered based on the Kerala leader’s complaint. The six accused named in the FIR are Janam TV, Karma News, Daily Hunt, Bharat Live, Janmabhumi daily, and Kannur evening daily Sudhinam

title: Hyderabad’s Golden Bonam offered to Goddess Kanaka Durga in Vijayawada
content: Thousands of devotees participate in the traditional Bonalu procession as temple authorities suspend VIP darshan and strengthen crowd management arrangements in view of the expected surge in pilgrim turnout

title: Jharkhand Ex-CM Champai urges High Court to take suo motu cognisance of JPSC, JSSC ‘irregularities’
content: The Jharkhand High Court should take suo motu cognisance of this matter and order a CBI probe into every single recruitment process conducted by JSSC and JPSC over the last few years, said Champai Soren

title: Kerala High Court judges inspect Thrissur mental health centre, reviews facilities
content: Officials say the inspection was part of the court’s broader exercise of visiting government mental health institutions across the State in connection with cases dealing with their infrastructure and standards of care

title: Kerala Congress urges Centre to take steps for a new Mullaperiyar dam
content: Two-day State leadership camp of Kerala Congress held at Charalkunnu in Pathanamthitta on Friday (July 24, 2026) and Saturday (July 25, 2026)

title: Modi must answer for deaths of 90 students linked to exam scandals, says Kerala Minister O.J. Janeesh
content: He says the country witnessed question paper leaks on five different occasions, and Dharmendra Pradhan should have accepted moral responsibility and resigned immediately after the first such incident

title: 'This is a new subject for me': Pralhad Joshi after taking charge as education minister
content: Pralhad Joshi has taken charge as the Union Education Minister. He is reviewing the ministry's functioning and familiarizing himself with its operations. Joshi expressed gratitude to Prime Minister Narendra Modi for this new responsibility. This change follows Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation from the Union Council of Ministers. The ministry change occurs amid student protests over examination irregularities.

title: Romania shoots down third suspected Russian drone in three days, summons Moscow's envoy
content: Romania shot down a drone entering its airspace over the Black Sea. This marked the third such interception in as many days. President Nicusor Dan condemned these repeated violations as intolerable and unacceptable. Romania summoned the Russian ambassador to protest these airspace breaches. Investigations are ongoing into the drone incidents and border tensions are high.

title: 'Misleading': MEA fact-checks viral claim on spokesperson Jaiswal's CJP protest remarks
content: The Ministry of External Affairs clarified a misleading social media post regarding protest funding. Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated he had no information on foreign funding claims. This clarification followed viral posts attributing false statements to the spokesperson. The CJP-led protests concluded after the government accepted all their demands. Union minister Pralhad Joshi received additional charge of the education ministry.

title: Can China’s electric rocket launcher make Musk’s chemical rockets obsolete?
content: China has successfully achieved the recovery of an orbital-class rocket booster, similar to the reusable models pioneered by SpaceX. Recently, they conducted a test on electromagnetic launch systems, focusing on the initial lift-off phase. This innovative technology aims to lessen the dependency on chemical propellants, potentially making space launches more affordable and enhancing payload capabilities. Such advancements highlight China's escalating aspirations within the global space sector.

title: Chanambam Rishikanta Singh wins silver in weightlifting, sets CWG record
content: Chanambam Rishikanta Singh secured the silver medal in the men's 60kg weightlifting event. He set a new Commonwealth Games record in the snatch discipline. Malaysia's Mohamad Aniq Bin Kasdan won the gold medal in the competition. Rishikanta's performance marked India's first medal in weightlifting at the Games. This achievement highlights India's continued strength in Commonwealth weightlifting.

title: 'Don't cry later': Owaisi makes alliance offer to Akhilesh to oust BJP in UP polls
content: During a rally in Moradabad, the Hyderabad Lok Sabha MP said he was ready to "join hands" or "form alliance" with Samajwadi Party, which would be cautious with the offer as both parties reach out to same voter base in the 403-seat assembly. Brushing off the BJP's "B-team" tag, Owaisi said he doesn't want BJP to continue in power for the third straight term in the state given that Samajwadi Party ties up with AIMIM to avoid the split of votes.

title: Why is Prince Yadav not playing 3rd T20I vs Zimbabwe? BCCI reveals reason
content: "Prince Yadav was unavailable for selection in the third T20I due to a hamstring niggle which he sustained while bowling in the second T20I against Zimbabwe," the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) said after the toss.

title: Baby crib sent flying, 800k flee: Typhoon Noul hits China, 10 dead; scary visuals emerge
content: Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China's Guangdong province early Sunday.  More than 800,000 people were relocated to safer areas in Guangdong.  Hong Kong experienced significant transport chaos with hundreds of flights cancelled.  Dramatic videos of the storm's impact quickly went viral on social media.  The typhoon weakened inland but heavy rain threats continue through Tuesday.

title: R Madhavan praises Amitabh Bachchan's age-appropriate roles
content: R Madhavan shares his respect for Amitabh Bachchan's impressive career longevity and adaptability. He wishes to mirror Bachchan’s ability to resonate in cinema throughout the decades. Madhavan highlights how Bachchan’s thoughtfully chosen roles reflect maturity and grace. He acknowledges the foundational role his parents played in shaping his character and happiness, as he looks forward to upcoming film projects that align with his aspirations.

title: 'Politics has become corrupted': Siddaramaiah says won't contest 2028 Karnataka polls
content: Senior Congress leader Siddaramaiah will not contest the 2028 Karnataka assembly elections. He cited advancing age and declining health as primary reasons for this decision. Siddaramaiah also expressed concerns about growing corruption within the political field. He stated that he will remain active in public life and serve the people. The veteran leader has dedicated five decades to public service and public life.

title: Housing society fines: Who pays when the flat is rented — owner or tenant?
content: Housing societies primarily hold flat owners responsible for rule violations and fines.  However, tenancy agreements can shift this financial burden to the tenant.  Owners may recover penalties from tenants if the lease agreement permits.  Indian housing laws generally establish the owner as the society's registered member.  Ultimately, lease terms and violation circumstances determine who pays the housing society penalties.

title: IPO rush ahead: Zepto, Shiprocket and 12 more firms to hit primary market
content: India's IPO market is preparing for a busy month with many companies planning public offerings. Over a dozen firms are expected to launch initial public offerings, raising over Rs 25,000 crore. These upcoming issues span diverse sectors like quick commerce, housing finance, and education infrastructure. This activity follows sustained momentum in the primary market throughout the current year. Market participants anticipate robust fundraising as companies leverage improving investor sentiment.

title: Pradhan offered to quit on 1st day of student protest? BJP leader's big claim
content: MP minister Vijayvargiya, speaking to news agency PTI in Indore on Saturday, said Pradhan had informed the BJP leadership that he was willing to resign if the party believed it was necessary. "On the first day, as soon as the student agitation began, Pradhan had told the BJP president that if he felt it was necessary, he was ready to resign as education minister," Vijayvargiya said.

title: Can the government take control of foreign-funded assets? FCRA Bill explained
content: The Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, introduced in the Lok Sabha in March, proposes a new framework for managing foreign contributions and assets when an organisation’s registration is cancelled, surrendered or ceases. The government says the changes are intended to address administrative and legal gaps, while critics question the breadth of the proposed powers.

title: Putin preparing to send more Russians to war': Zelenskyy claims losses now exceed recruitment
content: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has raised alarms about a potential new military mobilization by Russia, citing a concerning trend of battlefield losses that surpass the number of new recruits. According to Kyiv’s intelligence, a significant wave of recruitment is anticipated this autumn, yet reports suggest that Moscow has struggled to meet its recruitment goals this year.

title: Jana Nayagan box office crosses Rs 100 crore, earns Rs 14.86 crore on day 4
content: Thalapathy Vijay's 'Jana Nayagan' is experiencing a successful theatrical run and record-breaking opening. The political action drama has garnered significant box office collections in its first weekend. Its India net collection has surpassed one hundred crore rupees after three days. The Tamil version significantly contributes to the film's overall box office performance. 'Jana Nayagan' has also achieved substantial worldwide gross collections.

title: '52 tonnes waste cleared': NDMC races to restore Jantar Mantar after CJP protest
content: The New Delhi Municipal Corporation has launched a robust clean-up initiative at Jantar Mantar, with plans to eliminate around sixty metric tonnes of waste from the protest grounds. The operation, supervised by civic staff, involved sanitation workers and heavy machinery working around the clock. Efforts included repainting and fixing the area, prompted by a notable increase in litter following recent protests.

title: 4 killed, several injured in massive explosion at Assam rod manufacturing unit
content: A massive explosion at a rod manufacturing unit killed four workers. Several other workers sustained injuries in the incident on Sunday. The blast occurred at the KD Global Infrastructure plant in Cachar district. Rescue teams rushed to the spot and launched immediate relief operations. Authorities have initiated an investigation to determine the exact cause.

title: India Test squad hit by injury crisis ahead of Sri Lanka tour; Bumrah, Sundar face fitness race
content: Several key Indian players face fitness issues ahead of the Sri Lanka Test tour.  Washington Sundar and Jasprit Bumrah are among those with injury concerns.  Sai Sudharsan is also likely to be picked subject to his recovery.  Harshit Rana and Nitish Kumar Reddy are unavailable due to unhealed injuries.  The team's fitness levels are a concern for future tournaments.

title: Open drain, broken barriers: Hazards on Delhi stretch where 20-yr-old, US student died
content: A 20-year-old student died after his car skidded and plunged into an open drain. The drain remained largely uncovered and lacked adequate safety barriers for public protection. Locals blamed civic authorities for alleged apathy and repeated unaddressed complaints about the hazard. The Delhi Development Authority stated a proposal for a box drain was under process. Traffic police deemed speed breakers unfeasible for accident prevention on Nangal Dewat Road.

title: Student housing made easier: How MP's Aawaas Sahayata Scheme supports tribal youth
content: The Aawaas Sahayata scheme significantly benefits Scheduled Tribe students in Madhya Pradesh by providing essential support for their higher education outside their hometowns. To qualify, students must not have access to government hostel facilities. The application process is streamlined online via the MPTAAS portal, ensuring ease of access. Important documentation required includes an Aadhaar card, domicile certificate, and caste certificate for proper verification.

title: 'PM Modi's apology awaited': Opposition to keep up NEET protest pressure in Parliament
content: Opposition parties will continue their Parliament pressure regarding alleged police brutality against students. Rahul Gandhi has demanded accountability from Home Minister Amit Shah for the protest actions. The INDIA bloc will finalize its strategy on the anti-paper leak bill soon. This proposed legislation aims to increase penalties for examination-related unfair means. The Congress seeks an apology from Prime Minister Narendra Modi for the alleged atrocities.

title: Stock market outlook: Fed policy, crude oil prices and Q1 earnings to drive trade
content: Markets anticipate another volatile week as investors track Middle East developments and oil prices. The US Federal Reserve's policy meeting outcome will also significantly influence investor sentiment. Domestic economic signals will emerge from the release of June Industrial Production data. A busy earnings season featuring heavyweight companies is expected to drive stock-specific movements. Investors will closely scrutinize the Federal Reserve's assessment of inflation and growth.

title: 'Who approved pellet guns?' Rahul writes to Shah over 'barbaric' assault on students
content: "Peaceful protest is crucial to any democracy. It is the government's responsibility to protect protestors and resolve their grievances through dialogue. Such brutal violence destroys every norm, and has outraged the country. Youth and students, the future of our country, are demanding answers and accountability. Their voice will be heard," he further wrote.

content: Dharmendra Pradhan Resignation Live Updates: Pralhad Joshi, new Education Minister has vowed to "work to the best of my ability and fulfil my responsibilities with dedication."

content: The incident took place at Eldeco Society in Sector 150 under the Knowledge Park police station area. According to police, the victims have been identified as sanitation worker Shashikant Sharma and security guard Akash.

content: Ishaan Tharoor, in a post on X, called for a ban on "boomers" using WhatsApp, while agreeing with Zoho co-founder and ex-CEO Sridhar Vembu.

title: 23 Forest Personnel Who Lost Contact During Patrol Found Safe After 2-Day Search In Assam
content: The personnel had lost contact while conducting patrolling, combing operations and an official forest survey in remote areas along the Dima Hasao-Karbi Anglong-Nagaland border, where network connectivity is limited.

content: The girl, given the pseudonym "Mei", died a week after receiving a spinal infusion of trillions of viruses designed to penetrate the brain for treatment.

content: With his resignation, the Education Ministry has now seen five leaders handling the portfolio during the BJP-led government's 12-year rule.

content: The protest was called off on July 25 after Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned amid the NEET-UG paper leak controversy.
